newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BEL-20 CLOSES AT NEW HIGH, MORE GAINS SEEN.
newsitem.headline: BEL-20 CLOSES AT NEW HIGH, MORE GAINS SEEN.

text.p: Belgian shares extended their foray into record territory on Thursday, outperforming neighbouring bourses on the last day of the current forward market account.

The Bel-20 index ended up 18.24 points, or 0.99 percent, at 1,855.41, its third consecutive all-time closing high. It also hit an intraday high of 1,858.84, with the index moving in a 15-point range during the day.
The outlook was positive with shares expected to continue rising over the coming weeks, dealers said.
Gains in chemicals and pharmaceuticals stock UCB and positive sentiment surrounding financials helped the index break above the psychologically key 1,850 mark.

UCB ended up 3,250 francs or 4.47 percent at 76,000 francs, the strongest performer in today's trade, after the company said on Wednesday it was talking to the European Monetary Institute about producing a polymer film-based euro bank note.
One brokerage said that if the outcome of the talks were positive UCB's estimated sales of its bank note polymer films could increase fivefold by the year 2000.
